verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss or delegate a bug or task. The only @-mentions documented are PR-comment commands: '@foreloop retest' and '@foreloop link YOUR-REF'. Those are adjacent controls for re-running checks and linking PRs, not conversation or delegation. Delegation in Foreloop works through approved task contracts that agents poll for, not through mentions in a thread.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task
